item.title: FLAGGING OPERATIONS SCHEDULED NEXT WEEK FOR MAINTENANCE WORK
item.description: The Missouri Department of Transportation is performing maintenance work in Johnson, Lafayette, and Saline Counties from December 15-19. All work is weather permitting. Brush cutting work is scheduled on three routes in Johnson County throughout the week.
